description: This file defines an Exception class within the device namespace, intended for handling exceptions related to the device settings module. It contains constructors, message and code retrieval methods, and a virtual destructor, serving as a custom exception class for the module.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: A class for handling exceptions in the device settings module, encapsulating error code and message, with appropriate constructors and methods.

methods.description: Returns the message string associated with the exception.

methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the exception.
